parameters.name: DrdsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the PolarDB-X 1.0 instance.

parameters.name: InstanceNames
parameters.description: The names of the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances. Separate the names with commas (,).

parameters.name: Weights
parameters.description: The weights of the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances. Separate the weights with commas (,).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds modify-rds-read-weight --drds-instance-id drds000000000000 --db-name test --instance-names rm-0000000000000000,rm-0000000000000000 --weights 14,86 --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds ModifyRdsReadWeight --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceNames 'rm-0000000000000000,rm-0000000000000000' --DrdsInstanceId drds000000000000 --Weights '14,86' --DbName test
